 1 | Knowing | 1 target | P | 10' | U
 2 | Locate I | caster | - | 100'/lvl | U

 4 | Detect Gate | 500'R | - | 100' | U
 5 | Locate II | caster | - | 1000'/lvl | U
 6 | Teleportal I | 1 target | 1 rnd/lvl | 100'/lvl | F

 9 | Locate III | caster | - | 1 mi/lvl | U

13 | Teleportal III | 1 target | 1 rnd/lvl | 1 mi/lvl | F

16 | Calling IV | 1 target | 1 rnd/lvl | 10 mi/lvl | U
17 | Locate True | caster | - | unlimited | U
18 | Teleportal IV | 1 target | 1 rnd/lvl | 10 mi/lvl | F
19 | Enhance Teleportal X | 1 spell | 1 min/lvl | self | U
20 | Calling True | 1 target | 1 rnd/lvl | unlimited | U
25 | Teleportal True | 1 target | 1 rnd/lvl | unlimited | F
30 | Enhance Teleportal True | 1 spell | 1 min/lvl | self | U
50 | Gate True | 1 target | 1 rnd/lvl | unlimited | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster knows one target for the purposes of the Calling and Teleportal spells
on this list. The caster can only “Know” one target per level of experience.
@@ 2
Caster learns the distance and a direction to one target that he “Knows.” The
target must be within the range of this spell or only the direction is
learned.
@@ 3
Caster is able to call on someone that he “Knows” and is within range of this
spell. Caster gains no power to make the target do anything; he only gains the
power to talk to him for the duration (one way communication only).
@@ 4
Caster learns whether there are any magical gates, teleportals, or other
magical portals in the area of effect.
@@ 5
As Locate I, except for range.
@@ 6
Caster opens a gate within 10’ of someone that the caster ''Knows'', and is
within range of this spell. The spell provides no communication with that
person, it only provides transportation. The teleportal will only remain open
for the duration of this spell. If the person steps through (it is his
choice), the teleportal immediately disappears and another gate opens within
10’ of the caster, and the summoned person arrives and the gate disappears.
The spell can be recast (within 1 hour) to automatically return the target to
where he was before.
@@ 7
As Calling I, except for range.
@@ 8
Caster’s next Teleportal spell that he casts (within 1 minute of this spell)
will allow three appropriate targets to step through before it closes.
@@ 9
As Locate I, except for range.
@@ 10
As Teleportal I, except for range. Alternatively, the caster may use the range
of Teleportal I and force one target that he “Knows” to move through the gate.
The target may make an RR, but if he fails, he is forced through the portal.
@@ 11
As Calling I, except for range.
@@ 12
Caster learns to where the target gate or magical portal leads.
@@ 13
As Teleportal II, except for range. The range for forcing a target is as in
Teleportal II.
@@ 14
As Locate I, except for range.
@@ 15
Caster sets up a magical field around the target gate, teleportal or other
magical portal. Beings attempting to pass through the gate must make a RR
versus the level of the caster with a special modifier of -30. Failure
indicates that the being takes a ‘C’ Impact critical and does not pass through
the gate.
@@ 16
As Calling I, except for range.
@@ 17
As Locate I, except for range.
@@ 18
As Teleportal II, except for range. Range for forcing a target is as in
Teleportal III.
@@ 19
As Enhance Teleportal III, except it allows up to ten targets to enter the
teleportal before it closes.
@@ 20
As Calling I, except for range.
@@ 25
As Teleportal II, except for range. The range for forcing a target is as in
Teleportal IV.
@@ 30
As Enhance Teleportal III, except it will allow one target per level of the
caster to enter the teleportal before it closes.
@@ 50
The caster can open up a teleportal next to any target that he “Knows”
(regardless of range). Alternatively, the caster can open a gate in any
location that he is very familiar with. This spell is accompanied with a
visual image of the caster that can verbally and visually communicate two-way
with anyone on the other side of the teleportal.
